name: Absorption Ratio Regime (15d, z=1.0)
description: PCA-based systemic-risk regime de-risking (Kritzman et al. 2011). Computes rolling absorption ratio (fraction of return variance explained by top ~N/5 principal components). When standardized AR shift > +1σ, markets are tightly coupled and diversification fails—shift to defensive assets (VUTY, SGLN, AGGU). When AR shift < -1σ, full risk-on. Between thresholds, 50/50 blend. Hedge against concentration risk and common-factor crises.
